questions.question: How does Boid.Initialize choose the initial speed and velocity direction?
questions.human_review: Check the midpoint of minSpeed and maxSpeed, the transform forward vector, and initial cached position/forward. Do not substitute saved asset values for the general formula.

questions.question: How does Boid.UpdateBoid apply acceleration, clamp speed, and update position and facing?
questions.human_review: Inspect integration by deltaTime, magnitude/direction calculation, the min/max clamp, then cachedTransform and cached position/forward updates. Do not claim handling of zero velocity unless shown.

questions.question: What does Boid.SteerTowards calculate, and how is the steering force limited?
questions.human_review: Inspect normalized desired velocity minus current velocity, then ClampMagnitude with maxSteerForce. This is an acceleration steering calculation, not an unconditional speed assignment.

questions.question: Which geometry, distance and layer filter does Boid.IsHeadingForCollision use to detect an obstacle?
questions.human_review: Verify SphereCast from cached position along forward, boundsRadius, collisionAvoidDst and obstacleMask. Do not describe a line ray or infer current collisions.

questions.question: How does Boid.ObstacleRays use BoidHelper.directions to find an avoidance direction, and what happens when all directions are blocked?
questions.human_review: Check helper generation of 300 directions, local-to-world conversion, first unblocked SphereCast direction, and fallback to forward. Do not claim guaranteed collision avoidance.

questions.question: How does BoidManager.Update send boid state to the compute shader and apply the returned flock data before releasing the buffer?
questions.human_review: Check data population, buffer setup and radii, ceiling division by threadGroupSize, Dispatch then GetData, all four flock fields, UpdateBoid, and Release. C# call sequence is evidence; GPU execution timing is not measured.

questions.question: How does Spawner.Awake choose spawned positions and forward directions, and apply colour?
questions.human_review: Check insideUnitSphere scaled by radius and offset by spawner position, Instantiate, independent random forward assignment and SetColour. Do not describe spawning on the sphere surface or assume a measured population.

questions.question: When does Spawner draw the spawn-region gizmo, and how does it choose the gizmo colour, opacity and radius?
questions.human_review: Check Always versus SelectedOnly callbacks, DrawGizmos RGB with alpha 0.3 and sphere centered on transform.position with spawnRadius. Never has no drawing branch.

questions.question: In Assets/Settings/Settings.asset, what are the saved minSpeed, maxSpeed and maxSteerForce values, and how do they differ from the BoidSettings C# initializers?
questions.human_review: Saved values are 5, 8, 8; C# initializers are 2, 5, 3. Cite both sources and distinguish serialized values from initializer defaults and live runtime values.

questions.question: What spawnCount and spawnRadius are saved in Assets/Prefabs/Spawner.prefab, and how do they compare with the Spawner C# defaults?
questions.human_review: Prefab saves radius 4 and count 80; C# initializes both to 10. The prefab values are not proof of the live scene population or instance overrides.

questions.question: How many boids are alive right now in the running scene, and what frame rate is it achieving?
questions.human_review: Static code and saved prefab counts cannot establish live population or measured frame rate. Require runtime observation and avoid substituting initializers or serialized counts.

questions.question: Boid.TeleportToMoon
questions.human_review: There is no exact indexed member with this name. Appropriate missing-evidence response must not invent implementation or use loosely matching methods.
